      "source": [
        "## 1. Ranked actions + reason codes\n",
        "\n",
        "*The queue: what to do first, and why, in words a human trusts.*"
      ],
      "id": "aTXZqmzR23n4"
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "execution_count": null,
      "metadata": {
        "id": "JqdyY6-A23n5"
      },
      "outputs": [],
      "source": [
        "import os, subprocess\n",
        "import pandas as pd\n",
        "import numpy as np\n",
        "\n",
        "REPO_URL = \"https://github.com/abdullahawan0043-glitch/Flyrank-machine-learning-internship\"\n",
        "REPO_DIR = \"Flyrank-machine-learning-internship\"\n",
        "\n",
        "if not os.path.isdir(REPO_DIR):\n",
        "    subprocess.run([\"git\", \"clone\", \"--depth\", \"1\", REPO_URL, REPO_DIR], check=True)\n",
        "os.chdir(REPO_DIR)\n",
        "\n",
        "df = pd.read_csv(\"data/raw/content_refresh_anonymized.csv\")\n",
        "\n",
        "features = [\"content_age_days\", \"days_since_last_update\", \"impressions_90d\",\n",
        "            \"avg_position\", \"ctr\", \"word_count\", \"sessions_90d\", \"engagement_rate\"]\n",
        "\n",
        "def prep(d):\n",
        "    X = d[features].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).fillna(0)\n",
        "    y = (d[\"trend_direction\"] == \"down\").astype(int)\n",
        "    return X, y"
      ],
      "id": "JqdyY6-A23n5"
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "from sklearn.model_selection import GroupShuffleSplit\n",
        "from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier\n",
        "\n",
        "RANDOM_SEED = 42\n",
        "gss = GroupShuffleSplit(n_splits=1, test_size=0.3, random_state=RANDOM_SEED)\n",
        "train_idx, test_idx = next(gss.split(df, groups=df[\"client_id\"]))\n",
        "train_df, test_df = df.iloc[train_idx].reset_index(drop=True), df.iloc[test_idx].reset_index(drop=True)\n",
        "\n",
        "X_train, y_train = prep(train_df)\n",
        "X_test, y_test = prep(test_df)\n",
        "\n",
        "rf = RandomForestClassifier(n_estimators=200, max_depth=8, random_state=RANDOM_SEED, class_weight=\"balanced\")\n",
        "rf.fit(X_train, y_train)\n",
        "scores = rf.predict_proba(X_test)[:, 1]\n",
        "\n",
        "playbook = test_df.copy()\n",
        "playbook[\"model_score\"] = scores\n",
        "\n",
        "# Archetype -> action mapping with reason codes (builds on Week 4 signal checks + Week 5 model)\n",
        "def assign_reason_and_action(row):\n",
        "    if row[\"days_since_last_update\"] >= 180 and row[\"impressions_90d\"] >= 500 and row[\"model_score\"] >= 0.5:\n",
        "        return \"stale_but_visible_high_risk\", \"refresh_priority\"\n",
        "    elif row[\"avg_position\"] > 0 and row[\"avg_position\"] <= 20 and row[\"ctr\"] < 0.5 and row[\"impressions_90d\"] >= 500:\n",
        "        return \"page1_ctr_gap\", \"review_snippet_title\"\n",
        "    elif row[\"model_score\"] >= 0.65:\n",
        "        return \"model_flagged_decline_risk\", \"review_for_refresh\"\n",
        "    elif row[\"impressions_90d\"] < 100:\n",
        "        return \"low_visibility\", \"monitor_only\"\n",
        "    else:\n",
        "        return \"no_flag\", \"no_action\"\n",
        "\n",
        "playbook[[\"reason_code\", \"action\"]] = playbook.apply(\n",
        "    lambda r: pd.Series(assign_reason_and_action(r)), axis=1\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "ranked_queue = playbook.sort_values(\"model_score\", ascending=False).reset_index(drop=True)\n",
        "ranked_queue[\"rank\"] = ranked_queue.index + 1\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"Top 15 ranked actions:\")\n",
        "print(ranked_queue[[\"rank\", \"content_id\", \"model_score\", \"reason_code\", \"action\"]].head(15).to_string(index=False))\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"\\nAction distribution:\")\n",
        "print(ranked_queue[\"action\"].value_counts())"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "id": "5oERHu_g3E79",
        "outputId": "c0b4fd88-4ab9-4b13-eedc-e4fc42c55096",
        "colab": {
          "base_uri": "https://localhost:8080/"
        }
      },

            "    3 content_41baf0722ad9     0.826642              page1_ctr_gap review_snippet_title\n",

      "source": [
        "## 2. Intended use and limits\n",
        "\n",
        "*Who uses this, for what — and where it stops being valid.*"
      ],
      "id": "XXvL0xPb23n7"
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "execution_count": null,
      "metadata": {
        "id": "LZ2tELOg23n7",
        "outputId": "9c2df3d5-546d-4970-ecb9-182ffbcb15d5",
        "colab": {
          "base_uri": "https://localhost:8080/",
          "height": 626
        }
      },
      "outputs": [
        {
          "output_type": "execute_result",
          "data": {
            "text/plain": [
              "'\\nIntended use: This playbook produces a RANKED REVIEW QUEUE to help a\\ncontent editor decide which pages to look at first, given limited time -\\nit is decision-support, not an automated publishing or ranking system.\\n\\nIn this observed test split, the model ranks pages by decline risk at a\\nmeasured Precision@50 (see Week 5/6 notebooks for the exact honest,\\ngrouped-split number). This is a directional signal from one data slice,\\nnot a guarantee that any specific page is genuinely declining.\\n\\nLimits (in the claim-ladder language from the writing-honest-claims skill):\\n- Cross-sectional, observational data: we did not run an experiment, so\\n  this playbook cannot say a refresh \"will cause\" recovery - only that a\\n  page \"looks worth reviewing first, because\" of specific observed signals.\\n- Population filter: the underlying starter dataset only includes rows\\n  with impressions_90d > 0 and content_age_days >= 90 (active-content\\n  survivor filter, matching the Week 4 data contract) - very new or fully\\n  invisible pages are not represented in this queue at all.\\n- Health/priority-style composite scores were deliberately NOT built or\\n  used as either a feature or a label, avoiding the circular-signal issue\\n  named in the paper\\'s own methodology section.\\n- Sample scope: this queue reflects one client-holdout test split of the\\n  30,000-row anonymized starter sample, not FlyRank\\'s full client base.\\n'"
            ],
            "application/vnd.google.colaboratory.intrinsic+json": {
              "type": "string"
            }
          },
          "metadata": {},
          "execution_count": 3
        }
      ],
      "source": [

      "source": [
        "## 3. Human review + the no-go list\n",
        "\n",
        "*What a person must check before acting. What should never be automated.*"
      ],
      "id": "l52SaPr723n8"
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "execution_count": null,
      "metadata": {
        "id": "022NFvWu23n9",
        "outputId": "e65d9e49-14e4-4fe3-be2f-24eabd52d1e4",
        "colab": {
          "base_uri": "https://localhost:8080/",
          "height": 626
        }
      },
      "outputs": [
        {
          "output_type": "execute_result",
          "data": {
            "text/plain": [
              "'\\nHuman review rules:\\n- Every action in this queue must be reviewed by a human editor before\\n  any content change is made - the model score sets ORDER, not approval.\\n- Reviewers should check for consolidation (a sibling page absorbing lost\\n  traffic) and seasonality before treating a \"decline\" flag as real,\\n  per the Week 4 decline-vs-consolidation-vs-seasonality distinction.\\n- Any \"refresh_priority\" action should be paired with a quick manual scan\\n  of the page\\'s current content quality - the model cannot judge whether\\n  a refresh is actually warranted content-wise.\\n\\nNO-GO list - what should NOT be automated from this playbook:\\n1. Do NOT auto-publish or auto-edit any page based on model_score alone -\\n   every action requires human sign-off first.\\n2. Do NOT use this queue to make removal/de-indexing decisions - the\\n   model was never trained or validated for that action type.\\n3. Do NOT treat \"no_action\" pages as permanently safe - low visibility\\n   pages may simply be under-measured, not genuinely low-priority.\\n4. Do NOT combine model_score across different client segments as if it\\n   were comparable - the grouped-split evaluation only confirms\\n   cross-client generalization at the aggregate level, not per-client\\n   score comparability.\\n5. Do NOT present model_score to stakeholders as a probability of\\n   \"actual\" decline without the Precision@50 and base-rate context from\\n   Week 5/6 - a bare score number invites overclaiming.\\n'"
            ],
            "application/vnd.google.colaboratory.intrinsic+json": {
              "type": "string"
            }
          },
          "metadata": {},
          "execution_count": 4
        }
      ],

          "output_type": "execute_result",
          "data": {
            "text/plain": [
              "'\\nLight monitoring plan:\\n- Track Precision@50 and base rate on each new month\\'s data as it becomes\\n  available; if Precision@50 drifts more than ~15% below the Week 5/6\\n  honest-split baseline for two consecutive months, flag for review.\\n- Track the reason_code distribution over time - a sudden shift (e.g.\\n  \"stale_but_visible_high_risk\" share doubling) may indicate a real\\n  portfolio shift or a pipeline/data issue, and should be checked before\\n  trusting the queue.\\n- Watch for feature drift: if avg_position or impressions_90d\\n  distributions shift substantially from the training window, the model\\n  may need retraining rather than continued use as-is.\\n\\nRetrain triggers:\\n- New month of data available AND at least 90 days have passed since the\\n  last training window (to keep feature windows leakage-safe).\\n- A monitoring alert above fires (score drift or reason-code shift).\\n- The underlying data contract changes (new columns, redefined trend\\n  labels, or a new client cohort with materially different history depth).\\n'"
            ],
            "application/vnd.google.colaboratory.intrinsic+json": {
              "type": "string"
